sloka: वरः खलु मयैतस्मै दत्तस्त्रिदशपुङ्गव ।स त्वया नानृतः कार्यो यन्मया व्याहृतं वचः ।। ७.२२.४० ॥
transliteration: varaḥ khalu mayaitasmai dattastridaśapuṅgava ।sa tvayā nānṛtaḥ kāryo yanmayā vyāhṛtaṁ vacaḥ ।। 7.22.40 ॥

translations.english: O mighty-armed Yama, son of Vivasvat, you of immeasurable prowess, indeed that demon should not be killed by your staff alone.
